text: At a recent community improvements meeting, residents of Chester Hill Road and Thorncliffe Avenue requested that the existing No Parking Anytime regulation be changed to No Standing Anytime on Chester Hill Road, west of Thorncliffe Avenue. Subsequently residents of the three properties that abut that section of the road in question signed a petition. The impacted residents discussed the merits of No Standing versus No Stopping on that stretch of road and chose to go with No Standing. In view of all this, the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District, has made the recommendation below.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the entire length of Chester Hill Road, west of Thorncliffe Avenue.
